scenario_summary: Customer is disputing an unrecognized $76 charge on his account and requesting a refund.

conversation.message: Hi, my name is Diego Martinez and I'm 30. I noticed a $76 charge on my account from two days ago that I don't recognize. I haven't made any recent purchases that I can think of, though it's possible I forgot about something small. Can you look into it, and if it turns out I really didn't authorize it, can you refund it?
Okay, I can look at that. Can you tell me your full name and age again so I can pull up the account?
I just said that, it's Diego Martinez and I'm 30.
Right, thanks. I see a charge for $76 from 'Global Tech Services'. Does that sound familiar at all?
No, I've never heard of them. I definitely didn't authorize that.

Look, I can't just refund things because you don't recognize the name. You'll have to fill out a dispute form, but I'm just going to escalate this to the fraud department since I don't want to deal with the paperwork right now.
Oh, okay. How long will that take? Is there anything else I need to do?
I've sent the ticket to them. They'll email you eventually. That's just our policy.

escalation_reason: Agent opted to escalate the dispute to the fraud department to avoid processing the claim personally.
